items.prompt: someone you know a little but who is not a close friend

explanation.en: An acquaintance is not a friend, only a person you know slightly.
explanation.es: Acquaintance es un conocido, no un amigo cercano.

explanation.en: A divorce ends a marriage legally.

items.prompt: unhappy because someone else has something that you want

explanation.en: Jealous describes the unhappy feeling about what another person has.

items.prompt: no longer on friendly terms with someone you were once close to

explanation.en: Estranged is used for relatives, partners or friends who have grown apart.

items.prompt: a feeling of understanding and easy communication between people

explanation.en: Rapport is the good connection that lets people talk comfortably.
explanation.es: Rapport no tiene que ver con report: significa buena relación o sintonía.

items.prompt: to become friends again after an argument

explanation.en: To reconcile is to end a disagreement and restore a friendly relationship.

items.prompt: an experienced person who advises and supports someone younger

explanation.en: A mentor guides someone in their career or studies over time.

items.prompt: a person you trust enough to tell your private feelings and secrets to

explanation.en: A confidant is someone you confide in. A woman can be called a confidante.
